W.note: Syllables 5-7-5 exact (pearl-lit high un-seen / na-cre-ous clouds bloom at dusk / win-ter's rar-est sky), nacreous clouds at dusk are accurately evoked and 'unseen' gestures at rarity, but 'winter's rarest sky' is a stock closer.

X.note: Syllables 5-7-5 exact (mid-win-ter ridge wind / one lens o-ver the pale peak / holds while air runs through), a lenticular cloud standing over a peak is accurately rendered and 'holds while air runs through' turns stillness against motion.

Y.note: Syllables are 5-7-6 because 'its cold edge sharp on blue' runs six, and the lenticular is accurate but nearly repeats X's idea with a flatter, more abstract close ('holds still in the moving wind').

Z.note: Syllables 5-7-5 exact (na-cre-ous glow spreads / a-cross the win-ter dusk sky / clouds no one ex-pects), nacreous at dusk is accurate and the last line lands a quiet turn, though 'no one expects' is a mild stock move.
